title: B3S agent output (b3s-solution-reader)
description: The publisher's printed worked solution, transcribed step by step from its IMAGE. The twin of B3/B3V for the solution block: the text layer (solution_lines_draft) is a cross-check, never the record. The agent COPIES the publisher's reasoning; it does not solve.

solution_stepwise.description: One entry per PRINTED step, in printed order, all maths in LaTeX. Never merged, never invented.

concludes.description: The option the WORKING arrives at -- which may differ from the printed Answer (N). 'unclear' when it does not clearly land on one.

figure_bbox.description: Box of a solution figure inside the solution image, in its pixels. Not transcribed here.

figures.description: EVERY drawing in the solution image, in printed order: its box in the solution image's pixels and the step it belongs after (0 = before the first step). One entry per drawing -- a solution with three free-body diagrams has three. `has_figure`/`figure_bbox` stay for outputs written before this field existed.

complete.description: false when the crop is cut off at an edge, so the solution visibly continues beyond it.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
